body:
**Parent epic:** #278

**Depends on:** #280 (O1_INTERFACE_CONTRACT); iterate with #281

## Outcome
An explicit whole-path electrical allocation and test plan for one zone, adjacent zones and eventual five-receiver load. Architecture changes do not reset existing budgets at each board.

## Deliverables
- Rebuild fitted load ownership by rail, device, state and board; distinguish supported/partial/unmapped/unserved loads and DNP. Allocate shared source→middle→front/rear rail and AGND/contact/trace/harness contributions, decoupling/bulk, dynamic loads and protection reservations.
- Carry existing applicable constraints unchanged until an explicit reviewed decision: combined branch+K common-ground ≤0.5 mΩ, combined rail transfer ≤1 mΩ, hot distribution ≤20 mV, full source/rail/return ≤0.20 V, GH ≤0.5 A/contact. Explain mapping to the proposed topology and avoid silently weakening an unmet requirement.
- Allocate reference error including contact/return offsets, load, drift, noise and capacitance. A local buffer does not automatically compensate remote ground/contact loss. Preserve shared octave source as the starting comparison; independent per-OSC references require separate calibration/drift evidence.
- Existing remote-control envelope ≤300 mm / ≤1 nF is a starting constraint; shared octave 1 nF is **aggregate across five branches**. Account complete connector/trace/cable/test loads and five receivers even during one-unit qualification.
- Keep continuous nearby return paths across the OSC zone; no ground slit or narrow single-point bottleneck merely to separate logical functions. No common audio/CV bus or unrequested digital replacement.
- Address rail ordering/missing rails, slow ramp/brownout, powered-off input/reference injection, reverse/misconnection risk, output loading/short recovery and safe fault-test limits. Record VEE5, source/protection and connector unknowns with their existing issue owners (#57/#59/#65/#247).
- Preserve old finite-coverage success and resistance failures separately. Reduced-load millivolt findings, finite paths, numerical certificates and capped/native partial checks cannot be reported as complete current/voltage/physical acceptance.

## Acceptance
All load and error terms have units, conditions, source and allocation; no unexplained budget resets, double-counted shared branches or omitted connectors. Independent electrical review can identify every unresolved term and safe later verification needed. No numerical/native campaign is launched by this issue.

## Execution boundary
Planning deliverable under #278; **not started by issue creation**. Read #278, AGENTS.md and circuit/WORKFLOW.md before later authorized work. No production source/CAD changes, native campaigns, merge, fabrication, ordering or energization under the organization request. Preserve five OSC/all 33 functions/438 centres, canonical boards, decision.json and KEEP_K1402_INCUMBENT. Use exact source hashes and distinguish proposal, source/model evidence, native evidence and bench evidence. Missing checks are NOT RUN. Do not restart parked #242/E16 prompts or reopen completed finite-path/552-omission tasks. Keep pre-existing electrical and physical defects open.
